name: Emma Goldman
summary: Goldman was a Russian-born American anarchist communist who campaigned against the state, capitalism, militarism, organised religion and conventional marriage, and for free speech, birth control, sexual freedom and the workers' direct action. She refused parliamentary politics and the vote and defended revolution and understood, without endorsing, individual political violence. After visiting Soviet Russia she condemned the Bolshevik dictatorship and Kronstadt's suppression, and in the 1930s she rejected dictatorship of every kind.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Rejected capitalist competition and the profit system as the root of poverty and war and looked to voluntary productive associations developing into free communism instead of market allocation.

public-ownership.rationale: Condemned the Bolshevik state's monopoly of economic life as 'compulsory State Communism' and state capitalism; wanted industry run by voluntary associations and workers, not by government.

unions-good.rationale: Credited trade unionism's existence to direct action and praised revolutionary syndicalist unions, but called the old craft trade unions conservative and their leaders corruptible, so support was qualified.

property-fundamental.rationale: Endorsed Proudhon's 'property is robbery' and called property the dominion of human needs, a monster to be struck dead.

worker-ownership.rationale: Her economic programme was voluntary productive associations, and syndicalist unions trained workers to take over and manage production and distribution themselves; she hailed Spain's collectivisation of industry.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Condemned police spying and Comstock's 'system of espionage' on private life and the hounding of Anarchists as targets of watching and raids.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Argued that stimuli that quicken the imagination are as necessary as air and ridiculed Prohibition as a farce, though her examples were mainly alcohol.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Held free speech means saying what one pleases and that the cure for the consequences of unlimited expression is more expression.

strong-leader.rationale: Warned the young against dictators and saviours and held dictatorship, left or right, can never solve social problems.

state-harmful.rationale: Defined Anarchism as the theory that all government rests on violence and is wrong, harmful and unnecessary.

empower-police-military.rationale: Denounced militarism and police terror and held standing forces signal the decay of liberty.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Held that suppression and persecution of prostitutes only worsen the evil, urged an end to the legal and moral hounding of them, and opposed registration and segregation.

decide-locally.rationale: Argued Bolshevik centralisation crushed local initiative and that methods must grow out of each place's needs; favoured autonomy and federation over the national centre.

rehabilitation.rationale: Rejected punishment, revenge and deterrence as failures and called reclamation commendable, though she thought prisons should be abolished and society rebuilt.

traditional-family.rationale: Called marriage a parasitic institution and the home a modern prison with golden bars; rejected state and church control of family life.

abortion-legal.rationale: Inferred: from her statement that an unwanted life forced into poverty did not seem sacred to her, her demand for free motherhood and her attack on laws against contraception; she herself refused to perform abortions and called them a tragic result of social conditions.

more-religion-public.rationale: Held the Church has been an obstacle to progress and has no place in the life of a free people.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Treated nation and tradition as burdens of the past and patriotism as a superstition, rather than values to preserve.

gradual-change.rationale: Said one cannot be too extreme dealing with social ills, that the extreme thing is generally true and that real change takes revolution.

free-trade.rationale: Contested: criticised tariffs as a government restriction on free exchange, but opposed the capitalist order that free trade serves.

nation-first.rationale: Denounced 'America first' as hypocritical nationalism that serves the privileged, and wanted universal brotherhood.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Argued the 1898 war was dressed as humanitarian but driven by sugar interests, and opposed Western armed intervention in Russia.

open-borders.rationale: Mocked the globe divided into little spots each surrounded by an iron gate and looked to a universal brotherhood, a free society uniting all nationalities.

revolution-justified.rationale: Stated that no real social change has ever come without a revolution, 'thought carried into action'.

central-planning.rationale: Argued Bolshevik extreme mechanical centralisation paralysed industry and agriculture and starved the country; centralisation is the 'death-knell of liberty'.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Listed tariffs among government measures that obstruct free exchange.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Described state direction of the economy under the Bolsheviks as a bureaucratic machine of appalling inefficiency and corruption, and opposed the state running economic life.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Said syndicalism aims at the complete overthrow of the wage system and held there can be no freedom while mercenary and commercial considerations rule conduct; envisaged free communism.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Condemned the Soviet 'governmentalized' unions that merely transmitted state orders and wanted workers' bodies independent of the state.

one-party-rule.rationale: Condemned the Bolshevik single-party dictatorship and its suppression of all other parties and criticism.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Condemned kings and thrones as tyranny, e.g. Spain's throne with the church and King Umberto's shooting of hungry peasants.

democracy-best.rationale: Said she opposed dictatorship and Fascism as she opposed parliamentary regimes and so-called political democracy.

workers-councils.rationale: Presented free Soviets and syndicalist bodies as the true form of workers' self-rule against the party state and sympathised with the Kronstadt call for power of soviets, not parties.

natural-rulers.rationale: Rejected rule of any kind and said anarchism leaves people free to organise, though she admired the creative minority.

political-violence-never.rationale: Contested: refused to condemn acts like Berkman's or Czolgosz's and called resistance to tyranny man's highest ideal, yet said she did not believe such acts can bring social reconstruction.

war-builds-character.rationale: Held war brutalises soldiers and nations and that patriotism turns men into machines.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Attacked the church and Puritanism, especially their entrenchment behind the State and law, as enemies of freedom.

military-superiority.rationale: Condemned the arms race and the US wish to put its iron foot on the necks of all other nations.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Said no national group in America can boast of race purity or special mission and held that one should outgrow nationalism.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Saw current class war as real but held that the individual (and minorities) have been the source and motive power of progress and that progress comes from minorities, not class conflict as such.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Named economic equality, together with individual liberty, as the twin forces of her ideal; envisaged free access to the necessities of life for all.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Praised Nora's discovery that she owes her first duty to herself and condemned social duty and sacrifice as tools of subjection.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Contested: deplored centralised machine production that makes humans particles of machines but also noted productivity far exceeds demand and did not call for rejecting industry.

restore-past-order.rationale: Said salvation lies in an energetic march onward and 'a dying age and a living truth'; she denied any wish to return to the past.

direct-action.rationale: Declared Anarchism stands for direct action and open defiance of laws, as against politics, and for the general strike.

means-match-ends.rationale: Argued the Bolshevik creed that the end justifies the means destroyed the revolution and that means largely determine the end.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Anarchist ideal of an order guaranteeing everyone free access to the earth and full enjoyment of the necessities of life according to individual desires, developing into free communism.

production-for-use.rationale: Held real wealth is things of utility and beauty and attacked an economy that serves property's 'gluttonous appetite for greater wealth'; foresaw profit motive passing away.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Said capital cannot grow fat unless it devours labour and wealth cannot be hoarded except through the poverty of those who produce it; producers are robbed of the fruits of their labour.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Rejected the Bolshevik 'dictatorship of the proletariat' as a dictatorship of a small party over the proletariat and called dictatorship, left or right, unworkable.

collective-farming.rationale: Contested: praised the collectivisation of land by Spanish anarchists as a great revolutionary achievement, but condemned compulsory Soviet collective and state farms as dispossessing peasants.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Argued wars trace back to commercialism (Spanish-American war to sugar, Russo-Japanese war to concessions) and that capitalism needs militarism; government lets the rich make wars for foreign markets.

taxation-theft.rationale: Listed 'stealing in the form of taxes' among the State's crimes and said government exacts taxes from production.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Held the individual is the true reality and that society and the nation are only collections of individuals, with the individual not existing for them.

conscription.rationale: Led the No-Conscription League and was tried for opposing the draft; condemned conscription as legalised slaughter.

positive-liberty.rationale: Mocked the 'free' American citizen, 'free to starve', whose political rights left him chained, and said a perfect personality needs freedom to choose work and its conditions.

total-state.rationale: Opposed every form of dictatorship, Fascism and State control of life as the negation of individual liberty.

national-rebirth.rationale: Treated nationalist glorification as poison and looked to individual and social liberation rather than a national renewal.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Condemned imperial annexation (the Philippines) and the pride in making America the most powerful nation.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Reported by a reference source as critical of Zionism as another failed experiment in state control; no primary statement was found.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Wanted workers to manage production through their own associations and syndicates rather than under owners or the state.

economic-freedom.rationale: Held that political rights without economic freedom are hollow chains and that freedom requires an end to wage dependence; she did not frame it as a defence of markets.

national-self-determination.rationale: Contested: sympathised with Cuban, Philippine, Riff and Mexican independence struggles, but held that states themselves are the enemy.

force-without-un.rationale: Opposed state use of force abroad as imperial or capitalist adventure.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Mixed: attacked faith and superstition but celebrated passion, love and feeling over cold correctness, so reason alone as guide is not her stance.

class-collaboration.rationale: Stated that the interests of capital and labour are as wide apart as the poles and can never be reconciled; condemned elements that reconcile the irreconcilable.

workers-nation.rationale: Said workers' solidarity of interest is international and greater than with their exploiting compatriots.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Demanded all vocations be open to women and rejected woman's confinement to kitchen and nursery.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Said she never had prejudice against coloured people and hated discrimination; she pitied Black Americans treated like slaves.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Held that government is necessary only to maintain and protect property and monopoly and that it protects the strong at the expense of the weak.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Criticised 'cheap Americanism' that robs the alien of originality and defended the melting pot against jingo slogans.

national-mission.rationale: Denounced US imperial pretensions and a nation that would plant its iron foot on all others.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Said women are reared as sex commodities, kept dependent by marriage and treated by sex rather than merit in the labour market, with a double standard of morality.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Opposed any government, including one limited to defence and enforcement of property, since it exists to protect property and monopoly.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Inferred: from her insistence that intimacy between a man and a woman is 'their own affair, their sacred own' and love needs no outside permission.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Inferred: from her stated principle that free thought and free expression need no legal chain and that heresy laws are the old inquisition.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Held the Bolshevik exaltation of the state and its centralised dictatorship to be what killed the revolution, and called government unnecessary and harmful.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Called it the most brutal imposition for one set of people to make laws that others are coerced to obey, implying legitimacy needs consent.

population-transfer.rationale: Inferred: from her own deportation, which she condemned as a denial of America's past as asylum, and her view of the State as the enemy of political refugees.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Contested: held Anarchism values life above things yet justified forceful resistance and revolution as understandable and sometimes necessary responses to tyranny.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Contested: held mutual aid and cooperation, as in Kropotkin, central to society while also praising the individual's struggle for liberty against authority.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Defended the freedom of Anarchists and every unpopular movement against suppression, holding that repression breeds violence.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Defined Anarchism as liberation from the dominion of religion, property and government, with wage slavery as bondage.

vanguard-party.rationale: Opposed a ruling revolutionary party and said the masses must shape the revolution through their own initiative and the party's dictatorship killed it.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Attacked labour laws that prohibit boycott and picketing and Australian compulsory arbitration that made unsanctioned strikes a crime.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Held poverty arises not from the earth's lack of fertility but because the earth is monopolised by the few.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Denounced wartime raids, the Espionage Act prosecution and military dictatorship in Colorado as violations of liberty.

party-controls-media.rationale: Condemned Bolshevik censorship and suppression of free speech and press and demanded unrestricted expression.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Sided with the view that party programmes wring the necks of living truths and rejected coercive organisation.

clerical-rule.rationale: Described the Catholic Church's use of the Spanish state to crush heretics, and the Church as a 'dominion of darkness', as a crime to be ended.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Urged workers and soldiers to refuse to fight great-power wars and hailed mutinies, though she did not call for defeating their own government.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Attacked Puritan censorship of art, books and the mails, led by Anthony Comstock, as an enemy of freedom and beauty.

death-penalty.rationale: Named killing 'in the form of war and capital punishment' among the State's crimes.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Said ignorance of sex fuels prostitution and welcomed the introduction of sex physiology in German schools as a result of radical drama; she opposed state schooling in general.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Backed Ferrer's schools free of dogma and held religion a superstition obscuring knowledge, opposing church-driven teaching.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Condemned Comstock's powers over books, art and the mails and the legal censorship of material on sexual matters.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Called public opinion the omnipresent tyrant and urged defying 'internal tyrants' of convention so people can listen to their own nature.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Rejected the claim that Russian conditions justified terror, censorship and conscription of labour and said the means paralysed the country.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Called Soviet Russia 'the crassest form of state capitalism economically' and an absolute despotism, denying it was Communism.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Rejected God, the State and rulers as claims to subordinate individuals and ridiculed divine-right claims.

character-from-environment.rationale: Argued character and crime are shaped by economic and social surroundings ('every society has the criminals it deserves') and that heredity is not the sole factor; human nature is plastic.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Held government's keynote is injustice and rejected the king who could do no wrong.

leader-cult.rationale: Condemned the Bolshevik 'worshippers at Stalin's shrine and Lenin's tomb' as puppets and obsessed bigots.

land-redistribution.rationale: Described the peasants' seizure of the big estates and the workers' takeover of factories in 1917 as the true social revolution.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Held Church and State persecution of heretics and godless belief a crime and defended Ferrer against that charge.

women-must-cover.rationale: Attacked the Puritan shame of the body, saying chastity varies with the amount of clothing, and defended nakedness' hygienic value.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Wrote that the new order rests on the materialistic basis of life and that the main evil is economic, while insisting every phase of life matters.

moral-incentives.rationale: Foresaw the gain motive being replaced by the creative urge and work as an instrument of joy once exploitation ends, without endorsing a duty-based incentive system.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Said she did not believe violent acts by individuals can bring social reconstruction, which needs education, example and mass economic protest.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Attacked hereditary monarchy and class privilege as parasitism on those who work.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Condemned US rule in the Philippines and Cuba and the pose of liberator hiding sugar interests.

patriotic-education.rationale: Attacked military drill and patriotic glorification of war in school curricula as poisoning children's minds.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Held the Constitution has been no safeguard of liberty and has robbed Americans of self-reliance and thought.

minority-veto.rationale: Rejected majority rule, endorsed Thoreau against winning by power of the majority, and wanted free groupings by consent only.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Said resistance to tyranny is man's highest ideal, but she denied that constitutional or legal limits protect liberty.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Held the history of parliamentarism shows nothing but failure and defeat for the people.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Mocked charity from the privileged who rob with nine fingers and give libraries with the tenth.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Spent her life in active agitation and held social reconstruction needs organised education and economic protest.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Said the army and navy are toys for a 'million-headed child', the press creates hysteria and the people are fed standardised fare.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Contested: held authority rests on the mass's willingness to be soldiers, policemen and jailers, and on schooled reverence, but also on force and terror.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Rejected Fascism and every dictatorship alike, saw 'no marked difference' between Stalin and Trotsky's dictatorship and compared Soviet and Hitlerite methods.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Opposed militarism and condemned militias and armies used against strikes and the people.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Listed divorce laws among government's moral impositions on free spirits and held love dwells only in freedom, lasting a brief span or eternity.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Anarchism as she described it guarantees every human being free access to the earth, while the land monopoly is condemned; she did not specify community or national title.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Criticised the American devotion to display, finery and the dollar as the measure of everything.

corporate-influence.rationale: Said politicians act for their financial and industrial allies and that courts, legislatures, press and schools serve the rich minority.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Said king, president, capitalist and priest demand 'the race' be preserved by indiscriminate breeding and defended free choice of fewer, better children.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Endorsed Thoreau's view that respect for law makes people agents of injustice and urged open defiance of all laws and restrictions.

non-intervention.rationale: Condemned US aid to Diaz and imperial adventures abroad, though she also welcomed international solidarity among peoples.

industrial-unions.rationale: Presented French-style syndicalism, organised by industry along autonomous industrial lines, as the right form of labour organisation against old trade-union methods.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Argued marriage and love are antagonistic, that marriage is an economic insurance pact and 'State and Church-begotten weed', and that love needs no legal protection.

religious-nation.rationale: Rejected nationalism and the religious grounds of national identity as superstitions.

religion-illusion.rationale: Said religion is a superstition that arose from mental inability to explain nature and that science will displace it, though she did not tie it to material conditions.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Held that women's economic and social inferiority causes prostitution and that equality demands abolition of industrial slavery, while also insisting true emancipation begins in the woman's soul.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Envisaged voluntary productive groups, communities and societies loosely federated, developing into free communism.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Contested: rejected capitalism and Bolshevik state communism alike while still calling her own goal free communism.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Lectured openly on homosexuality against comrades' objections, said she would plead for every victim of moral prejudice, and was praised by Hirschfeld for defending gay people.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Condemned the Bolsheviks' arbitrary suppression of all other movements and the stifling of criticism.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Held up Ferrer's execution over 'godless' schools as a church-state crime and defended free thought against religious prosecution.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Called the annexation of the Philippines an act of treachery and condemned imperial exploitation of dependencies.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Her case against Bolshevism was that the masses were denied the chance to shape policy and run their own affairs, and she wanted society rebuilt by direct popular participation.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Argued prostitution stems from both economic exploitation and sexual repression and that women of every colour are caught, though she did not use this framework.

alienated-labor.rationale: Stated that under capitalism the producer is robbed of free initiative and originality and turned into a mere particle of a machine, whose work is deadening rather than creative.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Held God, the State and society to be non-existent as sources of authority and rejected authority from above.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Held a standing army and navy signal the decay of liberty and Anarchists are the only true advocates of peace opposing militarism.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Rejected rulers and hereditary power altogether.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Repeatedly condemned the capitalist press for lies and for serving the dollar, and said the press and schools are used to safeguard a minority.

racial-franchise.rationale: Inferred: from her condemnation of racial discrimination and prejudice and her view that the ballot is a weapon the disinherited need.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Inferred: from her view that marriage and love belong to the individuals concerned and that Church and State control of them is invasive, and her indignation that love between Jews and Gentiles was a 'crime'.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Said the wealth of the few gives power to subdue, crush, exploit and enslave, and that government is maintained to protect that monopoly.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Endorsed Kropotkin's verdict that the whole apparatus of prison and punishment is an abomination to be ended and said society might more safely abolish all prisons at once.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Criticised philanthropy and institutions that live off poverty as hypocrisy of 'sentimental reformers who rob with nine fingers and give libraries with the tenth'; no comparison with state aid was made.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Held a true relation of the sexes admits no conqueror and conquered and condemned marriage as the husband's sovereignty over the wife.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Condemned military drill of children in schools and posters luring youth into the services.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Condemned a society where those who always work never have anything while those who never work enjoy everything.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Denounced Christ's non-resistance as slavish acquiescence and held resistance to tyranny man's highest ideal.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Called the soldier a 'poor, deluded victim' of patriotism and rejected glorifying those who die for the nation.

independent-unions.rationale: Condemned the transformation of Russian unions into mere transmitters of state orders and the bakers' complaint that they were 'lackeys of the Government'.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Her indictment of Russia was that the masses were deprived of any part in shaping policy or administering their own affairs; unions and Soviets were emptied of power.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Pictured voluntary communities and societies loosely federated together, and syndicalist autonomy along industrial lines against centralisation.

person-over-state.rationale: Said the individual does not exist for the State, the society or the nation, which are only collections of individuals.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Held solidarity lies between workers across national lines and described Jewish and other peoples as victims of social conditions rather than separate interest groups.

racial-pride.rationale: Inferred: from her statement that she had outgrown nationalistic tendencies and her view of patriotism as conceit and arrogance based on accident of birthplace.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Contested: called the foreign-invasion rationale for standing armies a myth and saw state wars as capitalist ventures, which implies opposing aggressive war, yet she wanted armed forces abolished altogether.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Mixed: denied women would purify politics and called them 'narrow and purist' as politicians yet hoped woman would become 'a force for love, peace and harmony'.

arms-reduction.rationale: Documented the waste of rising armament spending and urged an end to militarism, aiming further than reduction.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Hoped that workers and soldiers would say to their masters 'Go and do your own killing'.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Syndicalism as she explained it rejects labour contracts and negotiation with employers in favour of direct action, though it still wrests immediate gains.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Rejected taking over political machinery; Anarchists propose to destroy government and statutory law, not use it.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Refused any iron-clad programme, leaving posterity free to try its own systems, and wanted society to try free forms of living on small scales.

sacred-nation.rationale: Called patriotism a superstition and a menace to liberty, born of conceit and arrogance.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Treated all religion as superstition and the churches as obstacles to progress, with no 'one truth' beneath them.

workers-own-party.rationale: Opposed all political parties and parliamentary methods, ridiculing 'good Socialist politicians' clamouring for workers' representatives.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Listed equal civil rights as good demands though of little use to propertyless women, and held women's equal capacity.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Called the definite sentence barbaric and inadequate and wanted prisoners given the hope of liberty.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Said Anarchists favour organisation by voluntary adhesion and oppose compulsory organisation that holds people by coercion.

premarital-sex.rationale: Attacked the double standard and the demand that unmarried women abstain from sex until a 'good' man takes them as wife.

women-suffrage.rationale: Contested: said she saw no physical, psychological or mental reason why women should not have the equal right to vote with men, but opposed the suffrage movement and held voting a fetish with no emancipating force.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Stated that religion, especially Christian, has condemned woman to an inferior and slave life, and that women are its chief supporters.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Called religion a superstition from mental inability to explain nature and Christian teaching a poison.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Mixed: in 1919-20 urged defending the Revolution against intervention, but by 1935 called the Soviet state state-capitalist despotism, with nothing on defending it from capitalist restoration.

national-church-status.rationale: Condemned state privileges for the Catholic Church in Spain and the Church-State alliance as enemies of liberty.

simple-living.rationale: Advised women to make life 'simpler, but deeper and richer', while criticising mass possession-seeking; she herself valued beauty and did not demand austerity.

equal-conscription.rationale: Opposed all conscription and told soldiers to refuse to do the masters' killing.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Held the State's killing in war and by execution to be criminal and condemned police brutality and the third degree.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Held that the earth is monopolised by a few to the exclusion of the many and that every human being should have free access to it.

self-ownership.rationale: Called for woman's right to her body (free motherhood) and the black man's right to his body, and said workers are robbed of their labour's products.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Denounced state favours to business such as Rhode Island leasing convict labour to a trust with free factory, power and heat.

wife-divorce-without-consent.rationale: Celebrated Nora leaving her husband and held a woman's relation to a man must rest on love and her own choice, not his authority.

unjust-law-not-binding.rationale: Quoted Blackstone that human laws contrary to nature are invalid and held law never made anyone more just.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Said wealth is produced by labour that is robbed of its product and that capital cannot grow without devouring labour, though she gave no formal theory of value.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Held patriotism a superstition that serves the rich and urged solidarity of workers across borders instead.

material-over-identity.rationale: Held the main evil is economic but that the solution must consider every phase of life, and she lectured on sexuality, homosexuality and birth control despite comrades' objections.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Condemned the Bolshevik party's control of economic life and its state capitalism with Soviet trade with capitalist states.

notes: Died 1940, so inference was limited to views she stated and marked 'Inferred:'. Her views on economics were stated as principles of anarchist communism rather than policy; topics of modern welfare policy (healthcare, wages, taxes) are left null. Her position on women's suffrage is contested: she saw no reason women should not vote but denounced the vote as a fetish. Her attitude to political violence is mixed: she explained and defended the motives of attentaters but said such acts do not bring about social reconstruction. Her view of Soviet Russia changed from early support for defending the Revolution (1919) to calling it state capitalism and despotism (1935).
